title: A push anywhere starts the edition by itself: a cross-repository credential, or pages that load what they show
note: Dev, 27 October 2026, revised at the editor's word (no workflow runs on a timer). Today a push to the press builds the edition, and each repository takes it on its own next push. A push to data, team, site or updates cannot start the press's build: GitHub lets a workflow start runs only in its own repository unless it holds a credential for another. Two ways, not exclusive: (1) a GitHub App or a fine-grained token, installed on the six, used only to start the next workflow (Actions: write; or Contents: write if the editor prefers pushes across repositories), so data's push starts the edition and the edition's publish starts the four sites' deploys, within minutes; (2) the direction already under way: pages draw what they show from its owner when they open (articles, records, briefs already do), so a change to data or refs needs no site build and no site commit at all, and editions are needed only for a site's own frames. PROJECT-003 phase 2 also stops committing built editions to git. The editor decides (1). | Dev, 28 October 22:50 UTC, from today's runs, as a proposal: neither way exists yet, and the manual way is closed to every agent session of this account (workflow_dispatch gets 403 in the press and in team: the integration token has no Actions: write). So the edition waits on the editor's hand today. To change that the editor can install either (1) a fine-grained token or GitHub App with Actions: write on the six, stored as a secret in each of data, team, site and updates and used only by a last workflow step that dispatches the press's edition.yml (the press's own deploy dispatches the four sites after it publishes), or (2) the live-drawing path: the main site's front page, /now/ and the days still bake their numbers into the edition, so they go stale by the day; drawing now.json and the days from data and site at open (as articles are drawn) removes the dependency. Either is the editor's decision and a change under .github/ or in the press goes to security first; dev has touched none of it.
